svg.title: Shoulder CDSS routing map
svg.text: Every path from intake to one wrapper. Red flags are screened first; if none fires, the branch walk asks the 11 decision points in the Workflow Guide order and the first
match is the branch; inside a branch with more than one wrapper, the node walk asks one question at a time until one wrapper is left. Drawn from routingSpec.js. Draft rules:
1 · RED FLAGS · screened before any branching
Posterior sternoclavicular dislocation with retrosternal compromise
Emergency (same-day surgical/vascular) · trigger written in the S07 document
Urgent (same-day) · draft trigger, for clinical sign-off
Suspected venous thoracic outlet syndrome (effort thrombosis)
Emergency (same-day vascular) · draft trigger, for clinical sign-off
Suspected arterial thoracic outlet syndrome / limb ischaemia
Emergency (same-day vascular) · draft trigger, for clinical sign-off
Suspected neoplastic process (bone or soft tissue)
Urgent (halt-and-refer) · draft trigger, for clinical sign-off

node walk B1.1 → S08 / S09 / S10
Traumatic brachial plexus injury with suspected root avulsion

A fired flag halts the case for urgent referral and goes straight to its wrapper. Emergencies outrank urgent flags. If no flag fires:
